title: NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
lede: NVIDIA's SkillEvaluator grades agent skills in three tiers, from static safety and quality checks to live sandboxed runs that compare an agent with and without the skill.

points: Tier 1 checks that a skill is safe, well formed and compatible with agent harnesses, using scanners such as SkillSpector and Gitleaks.
Tier 2 uses embeddings to flag guidance that repeats inside a skill or overlaps with others in a catalog.
Tier 3 runs a real agent in a sandbox, Docker by default via the Harbor framework, to measure whether the skill actually helps.
Static checks need no API key; rubric scoring can use free NVIDIA Build endpoints for eligible developers.
It can check changed skills on every pull request, and ships as a skill that Claude Code or Codex can load.
